title: OracleScreen-LILRB4 (HTS-Oracle v3): machine learning-guided discovery of myeloid immune checkpoint binders validated in patient-derived cells.
summary: Testing the top 200 predictions yielded binders with follow-up patient-derived cancer co-culture activity; no patient treatment outcome established.
